title: Solasta: Crown of the Magister
summary: Turn-based tactical CRPG closely based on the SRD 5.1 ruleset, emphasizing positioning, vertical battlefields, party building and dice-driven outcomes. Reviews often praise the faithful tactical implementation and co-op potential, while some report multiplayer synchronization problems and presentation roughness.

observations.statement: Turn-based combat built around positioning, attacks of opportunity, spells and vertical terrain is repeatedly identified as the game's central strength.
Co-op is valued by some players, but accessible reviews also report synchronization failures that can disrupt multiplayer sessions.
More than one review describes character presentation or production polish as noticeably rougher than the tactical systems.

steam_reviews.query: Steam Community review pages; Russian and non-Russian lanes attempted; accessible index sampled without archiving raw review text
